summary: Implemented the logging foundation and bounded verbosity setting (v1.1 Phase 10 task 10.1, ADR-020 clauses 1, 2, 3, and 5). Added the bounded ArrTags.Configuration.LogVerbosity enum (Off, Error, Warning, Information, Debug, Trace; default Warning) as PluginConfiguration.LogVerbosity; PluginConfigurationValidator now rejects an undefined level with a secret-free message; PluginConfigurationSnapshot carries the validated value; and the ADR-016 settings page exposes a bounded emby-select control that round-trips config.LogVerbosity while the persisted XML shape stays loadable (an existing ArrTags.xml without the element keeps the Warning default). Added the plugin-owned, provider-neutral gating boundary ArrTags.PluginLifecycle.ILogVerbosityGate/LogVerbosityGate, which maps the bounded verbosity to a Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.LogLevel (Off -> None; undefined -> Warning) and reads the effective verbosity from the current ConfigurationSnapshotService on every call, so a saved change applies without a host restart; it is registered by ArrTagsServiceRegistrator, which resolves ILogger<T>/ILoggerFactory through the host DI and registers no custom ILoggerProvider/sink and does not replace the host ILoggerFactory. Verbosity is excluded from the renderer configuration fingerprint and the renderer output fingerprint and never changes RenderVersion, so changing it never republishes artwork. This task adds no production log call sites (those are task 10.2) and does not rewrite docs/limitations.md SEC-5 (task 10.3). New tests in tests/ArrTags.Tests/LogVerbosityTests.cs (26 cases) cover the enum validation and secret-free message, JSON and XML round-trips plus the legacy-XML default, snapshot mapping and last-valid retention on an undefined level, per-level gating, application of a replaced snapshot without a restart, DI resolution of the gate and of host logging with the ArrTags.* category prefix, the no-custom-provider/no-host-factory-replacement check, the settings page control, and the renderer/configuration fingerprint and RenderVersion exclusion; DashboardSettingsPageTests was updated for the added emby-select requirement. Documentation updated: docs/architecture.md sections 6 (new 'Logging and verbosity' subsection) and 12 (verbosity row and paragraph), docs/data-model.md 3.12, README.md, PLANS.md (task 10.1 status/checkbox, Milestone Status row, Active Planning Scope note), docs/changelog.md (new Phase 10 section and task 10.1 entry), and docs/project-status.md (Next tasks).
